title: Thunq, A Brand Strategy Podcast
author: Reilly Newman
description: It’s time to think differently about brand strategy. Reilly Newman is a brand strategist and professional thinker who explores thoughts that dive deep into human behavior, business, psychology, and beyond. Thunq goes beyond typical brand strategy but takes a creative twist of application and daring thought exercises based on the principles that make humans tick. Thunq is the thought studio you've never thought of.
